input.content: import plistlib import systems def _write_plist(tmp_path, data): plist_path = tmp_path / "systems.plist" with open(str(plist_path), "wb") as f: plistlib.dump(data, f) return str(plist_path) SAMPLE = [ { "PVSystemName": "Sega Genesis", "PVManufacturer": "Sega", "PVReleaseYear": 1988, "PVBit": 16, "PVSupportsRumble": False, "PVRequiresBIOS": False, }, { "PVSystemName": "Game Boy", "PVManufacturer": "Nintendo", "PVReleaseYear": 1989, "PVBit": 8, "PVPortable": True, "PVRequiresBIOS": True, "PVBIOSNames": [ { "Name": "gb_bios.bin", "MD5": "abc123", "Description": "Game Boy boot ROM", "Optional": False, } ], }, ] def test_returns_markdown_string(tmp_path): md = systems.generate_markdown_tables(_write_plist(tmp_path, SAMPLE)) assert isinstance(md, str) assert md.startswith("# Emulator Systems Overview") assert "## System Features" in md assert "## BIOS Requirements" in md def test_sorted_by_manufacturer_then_year(tmp_path): md = systems.generate_markdown_tables(_write_plist(tmp_path, SAMPLE)) # Nintendo sorts before Sega (alphabetical by manufacturer) assert md.index("Game Boy") < md.index("Sega Genesis") def test_bios_required_produces_anchor_link(tmp_path): md = systems.generate_markdown_tables(_write_plist(tmp_path, SAMPLE)) # Required BIOS system gets a hyperlinked check mark and matching anchor assert "[✓](#bios-game-boy)" in md assert '' in md assert "gb_bios.bin" in md # MD5 becomes a Google search link assert "https://www.google.com/search?q=abc123" in md def test_no_bios_system_has_plain_mark(tmp_path): md = systems.generate_markdown_tables(_write_plist(tmp_path, SAMPLE)) # Genesis requires no BIOS, so its row keeps the plain cross mark genesis_row = [line for line in md.splitlines() if "Sega Genesis |" in line][0] assert genesis_row.endswith("| ✗ |")
